pointsSystem: Two-stage pandemic format with scores RESET between stages, so the official overall standing is decided by the FINALS only. Stage 1 (online, Sept 18-19): 30 athletes per division, 7 events scored on the standard 30-athlete Games table (100, 96, 92, 88, 84, 80, 76, 72, 68, 64, 60, 56, 52, 49, 46, 43, 40, 37, 34, 31, 28, 25, 22, 19, 16, 13, 10, 7, 4, 0 for places 1-30); only the top 5 per division advanced. Stage 2 finals (Oct 23-25, The Ranch): 5 athletes per division, 12 events scored 100-75-55-35-15 for places 1-5. totalPoints here is the official FINAL total = the sum of an athlete's finals event points (max 1200). To make per-athlete event points sum to that official total, the 7 Stage-1 events carry points:0 in this file (their points were reset and do NOT count toward the final standing); the real Stage-1 place and score are preserved for analysis. Overall ranks 1-5 are the five finalists ordered by finals points; ranks 6-10 are the next-best Stage-1 finishers, who were eliminated after Stage 1 (0 finals points). For ranks 6-10 the 12 finals events (2020-08..2020-19), which they did not contest, are recorded as place 6 (first position outside the 5-athlete final), score null, points 0.
sources: https://c3po.crossfit.com/api/leaderboards/v2/competitions/games/2020/leaderboards?division=1 (official CrossFit Games leaderboard API, men - per-event rank, points, scoreDisplay; primary source). Note: the API lists 20 'events' where ordinal 8 is a Stage-1 cumulative pseudo-event (score = sum of events 1-7 points); ordinals 1-7 map to raw 2020-01..2020-07 and ordinals 9-20 map to raw 2020-08..2020-19.
https://c3po.crossfit.com/api/leaderboards/v2/competitions/games/2020/leaderboards?division=2 (official CrossFit Games leaderboard API, women - same structure)

Reconciliation verified: Fraser finals total 1150 and Toomey 1025 match the API overall; men's margin 1150-605=545 and women's 1025-665=360 match the documented record finals margins. Every event's documented winner (raw file) places 1st where in the top 10.
